hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Kilen (also known as Hezhen), traditionally seen as a Nanai [gld] dialect or a mixed Nanai-Oroch [oac]-Udihe [ude], is not intelligible to (Middle Amur) Nanai (**hh:g:Sunik:Kur-Urmijskij**:5-10, **hh:hv:Kazama:Hezhen:1998**, **hh:g:Zhang:Kilen**) and therefore merits its own entry. See also: Nanai [gld], Oroch [oac], Udihe [ude].
